author: Sr_Pancake
body: Hello, My Name is _PancakePlayz_, i have been banned for force field, Im not going to lye i was using hacks against other hackers but im so very sorry for doing it. I hope u can unban me so i can go back to playing with my buds and have a fun time on avic. Im going to be honest with u i kinda cryed by getting banned so i deleted my hacks and never downloaded them again. I will respect the rules to what avic gives me. Please unban me.

replies.body:
Greetings, _PancakePlayz_.

Unfortunately for you, you have not waited a period of time long enough for your punishment to be lifted. You have yet to wait three more months before filing in another appeal explaining why you were banned and why you think you deserve another chance.

Sincerely,
